segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the last four digits on the invoice number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northline Facilities, and the invoice is INV-33984, last four is 3984. I'm reaching out again because ticket 52718 did not actually fix this; the August monthly subscription invoice still shows the 30-seat field team bundle twice, and this is my second attempt on the same issue.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. Let me pull that up in the billing tool. Okay, I see Northline Facilities, billing date August 1, total showing $4,860. You expected it to be $3,240, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Correct. We have 30 seats on the field team bundle at $1,620, plus the core platform at $1,620. The extra field team line is the problem.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, I can see two identical line items here: field team bundle, 30 seats, both dated August 1 through August 31. There is a note on ticket 52718 that a credit memo was applied for July, but I do not see the subscription setup changed in the admin console.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that explains why it came back. We need to pay by the 15th, but accounting will not approve it with the duplicate line sitting there.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Understood. I’m going to place a billing hold on this invoice so it won’t trigger a late notice while we review it. I can also attach the prior ticket and the current invoice screenshot to a billing operations task.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you send me something I can forward to accounting today?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I’ll send a short email confirming the invoice is under review, the expected amount is $3,240 before taxes, and no late fee will apply while the billing hold is active. Give me about five minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Fine. Do you know when the actual subscription record gets corrected?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I don’t want to promise it’s corrected until billing operations removes the duplicated bundle from the subscription record. I’m marking it priority and asking for confirmation before the September 1 run, but at this moment it is not changed in the system.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Please include the new task number in the email.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Will do. The task number is BILL-68412, and I’ll reference ticket 52718 and invoice INV-33984 in the email.
